note: E05: fitted with sample_prior = 'yes' (brm_args). post.prior_draws is brms's prior_draws() of the fixed-parameter fit, (8, 4) with columns Intercept, b (one draw shared by every coefficient of class b), sigma, sd_g: Stan's RNG draws them in the fixed-parameter run (seed 1, one chain per point), identically in two runs; the points leave the prior_* quantities out. hypothesis(): a point hypothesis's Evid.Ratio is brms's Savage-Dickey ratio, density_ratio(posterior draws of the hypothesis, prior draw of b minus the point, point = 0) (stats::density, n = 4096; reproduced from the recorded draws to the last bit), Post.Prob = ER / (1 + ER); hypothesis_seed 1 fixes the order in which brms permutes the prior draws, which moves that ratio only in its last bit. The one-sided hypothesis is as in D06. A point hypothesis on two or more parameters is left out: brms pairs their prior draws through a random permutation (R's RNG). conditional_effects() of the interactions x:z (each level of z) and x:w (w at mean - sd, mean, mean + sd: effect2__ is that value as brms labels it, rounded text, w the exact value), 100 x grid points each, 300 rows, the other columns as in D06. The AutoBayes formula spells out x * z + x * w (AutoBayes refuses a predictor repeated by two products)

brms.formula: y ~ x * z + x * w + (1 | g)

autobayes.formula: y ~ x + z + w + x:z + x:w + (1 | g)
